dimension_proofs.positive_path: For each eligible minute, STRESS' = min(1, STRESS+0.03) and FATIGUE' = min(1, FATIGUE+0.02); CharacterStat.java defines both domains as [0,1], and Stats.set independently clamps again. Time is a 0<=hour<24 clock with inclusion at 6 and exclusion at 18.
dimension_proofs.negative_path: At 5.99 and 18.00 the increments are zero; values already at 1 cannot exceed 1; there is no lower-bound subtraction, health decrement, percentage conversion, random term, or elapsed-time multiplier.

dimension_proofs.positive_path: GameTime.java:737-739 produces EveryOneMinute with zero arguments once when previousMinuteStamp differs from minutesStamp; the Lua file adds one no-argument handler at load and reevaluates exposure on every produced boundary.
dimension_proofs.negative_path: There is no exposure counter or minimum-duration gate, so one eligible boundary is enough to set the damage-named flag and apply stats, contradicting the copy's 'Prolonged' condition even though the one-minute cadence itself is low frequency.

dimension_proofs.positive_path: No cooldown is designed or encoded: consecutive eligible EveryOneMinute firings each apply the fixed increments, while each ineligible firing recomputes and clears only UT_albinoDamage.
dimension_proofs.negative_path: The true flag is not read before the next increment, no timestamp/tick field exists, and no Remove call suppresses future firings; therefore the flag cannot act as a hidden cooldown latch.
